spanish: Y expiará el sacerdote que ungirá a él, y que llenará su mano para sacerdotear en lugar de su padre, y vestirá los vestidos del lino, vestidos del santo.

findings.issue: The resumptive object אתו marks the priest as the one anointed by a 3ms subject; «que ungirá a él» makes the priest the anointer and él another person.
findings.spanishSpan: el sacerdote que ungirá a él

findings.issue: הַקֹּדֶשׁ is a common noun (holiness, set-apart thing, or sanctuary); «del santo» can be heard as a holy person.
«en lugar de» selects the substitution sense; the token is marked only as a preposition, so a spatial under-reading stays open.
The second construct is definite through the article on הַקֹּדֶשׁ; the second vestidos has no article.

notes: Sequential perfects as future, singular mano, and literal llenará su mano stay inside the tokens.
